senses.gloss: हृष्ट- + मानस हृष्ट- + मानस (vb. हृष्). adj. glad, happy, Johns. Sel. 14, 48.
हृष्ट- + रूप हृष्ट- + रूप, adj., f. पा, having the hair of the body erect with pleasure, Chr. 60, 33.
हृष्ट- + संकल्प हृष्ट- + संकल्प, adj. contented, glad, Nal. 24, 50.

हृष् हृष् (originally भृष्), i. 4, Par. (in epic poetry also Ātm., MBh. 2, 1219),
 1. To bristle, to be erect (as hair, especially of the body, a token of fear, or, more commonly, of pleasure), MBh. 2, 1757; Rām. 3, 50, 27.
 2. To be glad, Daśak. in Chr. 197, 6.
 --† i. 1, Par. To lie, to affirm falsely.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass.
 I. हृषित and हृष्ट.
 1. Having the hair of the body erect with pleasure, Rām. 3, 50, 27 (हृष्ट); MBh. 4, 1245 (हृषित); with fear, Rām. 2, 9, 34 Gorr.
 2. Standing erect (of flowers), [] Nal. 23, 17 (हृषित).
 3. Pleased, Vikr. 75, 1 (हृष्ट).
 4. Astonished
 5. Disappointed, deceived.
 II. हृष्ट, Smiling.
 --Caus.
 1. To delight, Chr. 27 10.
 2. To be glad, Man. 6, 57. हर्षित, Delighted, Pañc. 146, 22.
 --With नि नि, निहृष्ट, Pleased, Daśak. in Chr. 198, 4.
 --With परि परि, Caus. To delight much, MBh. 3, 887.
 --With संपरि सम्-परि, Caus. To delight completely, or much, MBh. 3, 17470.
 --With प्र प्र, To be very glad, Bhag. 5, 20; प्रहृष्ट, Very glad, Pañc. 241, 23.
 --Caus. To delight, Hit. iv. d. 9; प्रहर्षित, Very delighted, Pañc. 241, 16.
 --With संप्र सम्-प्र, संप्रहृष्ट,
 1. Erect (viz. the hair of the body), MBh. 3, 3061.
 2. Pleased, MBh. 1, 3107.
 --Caus. संप्रहर्षित, Much delighted, MBh. 3, 11829.
 --With सम् सम्, To be glad, MBh. 2, 941. संहृष्ट-रोमाङ्ग, i. e. -रोमन्-अङ्ग, adj. literally, ‘Having a body, the hair of which stood erect,’ Rām. 3, 55, 5.
 --With अतिसम् अति-सम्, अतिसंहृष्ट, Very glad, Lass. 2. ed. 47, 40.
 --With परिसम् परि-सम्, परिसंहृष्ट, Very pleased, Rām. 3, 49, 11.
 --With प्रतिसम् प्रति-सम्, To be glad, Rām. 3, 49, 11.
 --Cf. ϕρίσσω, ϕρίξ; O.H.G. burst; A.S. byrst, bristl, forst, frost, gelu; frysan; a-grísan, gerst, gryre; Lat. horrere, Hersilia; probably χέρσος, χήρ.

हृषीक हृष् + ईक, n. Any organ of sense.
 --Comp.
हृषीकेश हृषीकेश, i. e. हृषीक-ईश, m. Kṛṣṇa or Viṣṇu, Rām. 1, 45, 30; Rājat. 5, 100.
हृष्टवत् हृष्टवत्, i. e. हृष्ट + वन्त्, [] acc. sing. n., adv. Cheerfully, Johns. Sel. 59, 179.
हृष्टि हृष्टि i. e. हृष् + ति, f. Joy, Mālat. 82, 4; delight, pleasure.
